title: dxn dimension
description: Editor aid for dimensions/<name>.json; the file name is the dimension's name. The dimensions compiler is the authority: it also checks that the default is one of the values and that appliesTo names existing nodes, which this schema cannot express.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, for editors.

default.description: One of the values: the value a context means when it leaves this dimension out.

appliesTo.description: Ids of the nodes this dimension applies to; each node's subtree is included. Leave it out while the dimension applies to nothing yet.

name.description: Non-blank, without leading or trailing whitespace or control characters.
